headlines.title: Apple Intelligence is finally coming to China with iOS 27.3
headlines.summary: Apple will launch Apple Intelligence in China with iOS 27.3, the company announced on its Chinese newsroom website, as reported by MacRumors. The Apple Intelligence features will be available first in an iOS 27.3 beta that's set to launch on November 4th, with a full iOS 27.3 release scheduled for December.

concept.title: Fine-tuning vs Prompting
concept.body: Prompting steers a general model with instructions; fine-tuning retrains it on your examples. Prompting is faster and cheaper; fine-tuning suits narrow, repeated jobs.
concept.takeaway: Exhaust prompting and RAG before paying for fine-tuning — most needs never require it.
